constraints.translation: This is an NDA between the Company and AHPL.
constraints.reasoning: Constitutive statement defining the instrument and parties.

constraints.translation: Purpose means discussions/negotiations concerning establishment of a business relationship.
constraints.reasoning: Definition uses "shall mean" indicating strict meaning.

constraints.translation: Any information relating to AHPL patients is deemed Confidential Information.
constraints.reasoning: "shall be deemed" is mandatory; patient info is always treated as confidential under the agreement.

constraints.translation: Information received from the other party that is labeled/indicated confidential at disclosure is Confidential Information.
constraints.reasoning: The definitional language "shall mean" makes the implication strict.

constraints.translation: Orally disclosed information identified confidential and confirmed in writing within 15 days is Confidential Information.
constraints.reasoning: Bracketed clause sets a specific condition for oral disclosures to qualify.

constraints.translation: Oral information is not Confidential Information unless identified as confidential and confirmed in writing within 30 days.
constraints.reasoning: "does not include" is exclusionary/mandatory; represented as a hard implication to not-confidential.

constraints.translation: Public information (without breach) is not Confidential Information.
Independently known/developed information is not Confidential Information.
Information obtained from a third source without breach is not Confidential Information.
Information made generally available or disclosed without restriction is not Confidential Information.
Information disclosed with prior written approval is not Confidential Information.
constraints.reasoning: Express exception: approval removes it from the defined set.

constraints.translation: After five years from signature, information is not Confidential Information.
A combination of information remains confidential even if some components fall within exceptions, unless the combination itself falls within an exception.
constraints.evidence: Clause 1.2 proviso: "exceptions shall not apply to ... combination ... merely because ... (but not the combination itself)"
constraints.reasoning: The proviso expressly blocks using component-level exceptions to declassify the combination.

constraints.translation: Clause 1.2(a) information remains the sole property of the Discloser.
constraints.reasoning: "shall be and remain" indicates mandatory/definitional ownership.

constraints.translation: Clause 1.2(a) information must be returned to the Discloser on demand or upon termination of services.
The Company ensures no AHPL patient is identifiable in Company reports/submissions/publications.
Maintain the other party's Confidential Information in confidence.
Use Confidential Information only for the Purpose.
Do not make any commercial use of Confidential Information.
Do not use Confidential Information for own/third-party benefit except under further agreement.
Do not use Confidential Information to guide/conduct searches for any purpose (including to prove exceptions).
Do not copy/reproduce/reduce to writing except as necessary for Purpose.
Copies made are Discloser property.
constraints.reasoning: Mandatory ownership effect: "shall be the property".

constraints.translation: Do not disclose CI except in confidence to need-to-know persons for Purpose.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit prohibition with a narrow exception.

constraints.translation: If disclosure is made to need-to-know persons, those persons must be contractually obliged not to disclose.
constraints.reasoning: Structural requirement attached to the only allowed internal disclosure channel.

constraints.translation: Recipient enforces those confidentiality obligations at its expense and at Discloser request.
Recipient is responsible for its employees/directors’ compliance with the Clause 2.1 duties.
Apply no lesser security measures than for own similar confidential information; warrant adequate protection.
Company causes its personnel involved in the Purpose to be bound by the agreement.
Company is liable for breaches by its personnel.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit liability statement: "shall be responsible and held liable".

constraints.translation: Recipient may disclose CI if disclosure is required by law.
Give at least two business days notice before legally required disclosure.
Consult with Discloser prior to legally required disclosure to avoid it if legally possible.
Return CI documents/materials within one month after completion or written request.
Certify return compliance in writing.
Confidentiality undertakings continue after completion/return.
AHPL-provided data remains AHPL property.
constraints.reasoning: If data is within the defined AHPL-provided set, ownership follows as a strict rule.

constraints.translation: Company marks AHPL data as AHPL property on all media/documentation.
Company takes reasonable precautions and adequate measures to protect AHPL data integrity.
constraints.reasoning: "shall take" is mandatory; "reasonable"/"adequate" are standards but obligation is strict.

constraints.translation: On termination and AHPL direction, Company erases AHPL data and instructs agents/subcontractors to erase.
constraints.reasoning: Conditional obligation specified by the contract.

constraints.translation: Use AHPL data only for purposes of the Agreement.
Do not further process or disclose AHPL data without prior consent.
Do not transfer/make available AHPL data to third parties without prior written consent.
Transferring/making data available to a third party counts as disclosure, so it is also forbidden without consent.
constraints.reasoning: Common-sense semantic entailment: third-party transfer/making available is a type of disclosure/availability.

constraints.translation: No commercial/profit use of AHPL data or derived substances without consent.
No research use under external consulting/licensing obligations without consent.
On completion, return or dispose of data under supervision per laws and AHPL instructions.
Comply at all times with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.
No implied rights/obligations beyond what is recited in the Agreement.
No IP license is granted.
If Confidential Information remains the Discloser's property, then no implied license to IP rights is granted.
constraints.reasoning: Common-sense/contractual semantics: ownership retention supports the no-license conclusion.

constraints.translation: Each party warrants the right to disclose and authorize use for the Purpose.
Keep existence and nature of the Agreement confidential.
No publicity/advertisement/other disclosure using the agreement or the other party's name without prior written consent.
Consent for Clause 6 publicity is not unreasonably withheld.
constraints.reasoning: The duty is stated as a standard ("not unreasonably"), which is enforceable but evaluative; slightly less mechanically strict than pure "must".

constraints.translation: Breach or threatened breach results in irreparable harm.
Monetary damages are not an adequate remedy.
constraints.evidence: Clause 7: "may not be an adequate remedy"
constraints.reasoning: Text contains hedge "may"; proposition is asserted as a strong likelihood rather than absolute.

constraints.translation: Entitlement to equitable relief (injunction/specific performance) in addition to other remedies.
All Confidential Information remains the property of the Discloser.
Recipient does not file IP registrations/applications on the Confidential Information.
If Recipient files prohibited registrations, Recipient assigns them to Discloser without cost.
Comply with all applicable laws/regulations in performing obligations.
No liability for indirect/incidental/special/punitive/consequential damages except for wilful acts/default/gross negligence.
Notices are in writing unless expressly stated otherwise.
Notices are sent to the stated (or later specified) address.
Allowed notice delivery methods include hand, AR Registered post, or certified mail, properly addressed.
Hand-delivered notice is deemed served on delivery.
Singapore AR post notice deemed served two days after posting.
Non-Singapore AR post notice deemed served eight days after posting.
Agreement continues until terminated.
Agreement may be terminated by mutual consent.
Agreement may be terminated by 30 days' prior written notice by either party.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit termination mechanism with minimum notice.

constraints.translation: Listed clauses survive termination.
No assignment/transfer to third party without prior written consent.
Consent for assignment is not unreasonably withheld.
Permitted assignee agrees in writing to comply with agreement terms.
Assignment cannot exceed existing scope of the Agreement.
Invalid/illegal provisions are deleted and have no force and effect.
Remaining terms remain effective after severance unless impossibility/material change occurs.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit continuation rule with stated exception.

constraints.translation: If severance makes performance impossible or materially changes rights/obligations, party may give notice of intent to terminate.
Parties negotiate in good faith to replace deleted provisions with acceptable alternatives.
Waiver of one breach is not waiver of another breach.
AHPL indulgence is not a waiver and is without prejudice.
Use best endeavours to settle disputes informally.
constraints.reasoning: "Best endeavours" is a strong obligation but not as absolute as "must"; weight slightly below 1.0.

constraints.translation: Act in good faith and cooperate to resolve disputes.
No litigation/other dispute resolution unless reasonable mediation efforts have been made.
Party receiving mediation notice consents and participates.
Non-compliance with mediation requirement is a breach.
If mediation fails, dispute goes to arbitration or court by election via written notice.
Arbitration reference in Singapore is submission under the Arbitration Act.
Arbitration in English under SIAC Rules.
One arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement or by Appointing Authority after 30 days without agreement.
Chairman of SIAC is Appointing Authority.
Arbitrator must not be present/former employee/agent/consultant/counsel of either party or related corporation.
Arbitration award is final and binding.
Interest at 6% per annum payable on arbitration awards as specified.
Keep arbitration proceedings and related materials confidential.
Urgent equitable relief may be sought in court despite dispute resolution clause.
Dispute resolution proceedings do not suspend ongoing contractual performance.
Prevailing party recovers reasonable professional fees/costs.
Comply with export laws and regulations.
Do not export in violation of Export Laws.
Do not use for prohibited purposes (including WMD proliferation or missile tech development).
If a party avoids illegal export, it is (at least partly) complying with Export Laws.
constraints.reasoning: Common-sense semantic relationship: the specific no-illegal-export rule supports the general compliance obligation.

constraints.translation: If a party avoids prohibited uses, it is (at least partly) complying with Export Laws.
constraints.reasoning: Common-sense semantic relationship between the specific prohibition and the general compliance duty.

constraints.translation: Parties have read and understood the Agreement.
Agreement is the entire agreement; supersedes prior arrangements.
constraints.reasoning: Integration clause uses explicit superseding language.

constraints.translation: No other promises/inducements/representations beyond the Agreement text.
No partnership or agency relationship is created.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit negation: "shall be deemed" not to constitute partnership/agency.

constraints.translation: No party has authority to act for or bind the other.
If there is no partnership/agency, then no party has authority to bind the other.
constraints.reasoning: Common-sense legal semantics: absence of agency/partnership typically entails lack of binding authority (though contracts may separately grant authority).

constraints.translation: Governing law is Singapore.
Non-exclusive jurisdiction is Singapore courts.
Priority: Clauses override Schedules/Annexes in conflict.
